description: Synthetic decision fixtures covering the families the normalisation and provenance work has to keep apart. Every value is drawn from a documentation-reserved name (RFC 2606 example.com/.org/.net and subdomains of them, RFC 5737 192.0.2.0/24). No value here corresponds to a real registration, a real report, or a real person.
provenance_note: Written for this repository by this project. Carries no third-party rights question and no real-world validity: agreement between these labels and this project's own rule is a tautology, not evidence. See docs/EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md section 3.
baseline_note: An empty named list. It is named and pinned, which is what makes `additional` well defined, but it covers nothing, so `additional` here means `proposed at all` rather than `added on top of a household's real lists`. A protocol-conformant study replaces this with the household's actual blocklists, by name and fetch digest.
unsupported_note: url, email-address, crypto-address, username, ipv4 and phone-number cases are present and are expected to be reported as unsupported. They are here so that an unimplemented type appears in the results as unimplemented rather than being absent from them.
